name: hole_table_is_taken_away
why: 0.131.0, item 6 of the drawing branch, ported to the main line in bridge 0.171.0. The proof session of 12/10/2026 put a hole table on the front view and had no way to take it away: the only remedy was to redo the drawing. The main line already takes away a view («delete_view») and a dimension or a note («delete_annotation»), not a table. «delete_annotation» with «table» takes ONE table away by its place on the sheet (T1 is the first table SOLIDWORKS lists) and COUNTS the tables of the drawing before and after, because the answer of the call that removes it is not the measurement of the thing.
_what_changed_in_the_port: The case of 0.131.0 («delete_drawing_item_takes_away_a_view_a_dimension_and_a_table») also took away a view and a dimension through «delete_drawing_item». The main line does both with its own operations and its own cases (view_is_deleted, limit_delete_view_with_derived, annotation_is_taken_away), so only the table is kept here, with the argument «table» of «delete_annotation».
defect_caught: An operation that says «removed» while the table is still on the sheet, or that takes away a different table than the one named. The answer must say which kind of table went, and the count of the tables must drop by one.
